summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (or uses a system `bun`) and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with hex-obfuscated identifiers (`_0x...` names, rotated string-array constant table, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). The obfuscated bundle is not referenced from the advertised eslint-config entry (`index.js`) and only executes via the preinstall-driven Bun runtime. Executing an opaque 727KB blob via a freshly fetched alternate runtime at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the payload runs on the installer's host with no visibility to Node-based tooling, and an eslint config has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime to install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
